ann.t: Newspaper Add of Un-audited Finanical Result for the Quarter and Half year ended September 30, 2026

Svaraj Trading & Agencies Ltd has informed BSE that the meeting of the Board of Directors of the Company is scheduled on 13/11/2026 ,inter alia, to consider and approve the Unaudited Financial Results of the Company for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026.
